dispute.claim_text: The tracking says my package was delivered, but I never received it. I was home that day. The shipping label is also missing my apartment number, so it may have gone to the wrong unit.

evidence.text: Order confirmation: shipping address '220 Maple St, Apt 4B'. Amount USD 89.00.
Status: 'Delivered, left at front door, 2026-09-10 15:40.' No signature and no delivery photo. Label address shows '220 Maple St' with no apartment number.
Cardholder to merchant: 'Nothing arrived. I was home all day. The label is missing my apartment number (4B).'

labels.notes: Hard case. The critical point is genuinely contested: a delivery scan exists (leans merchant), but it lacks a signature or photo and the label is missing the apartment number (leans consumer). On balance the consumer's non-receipt claim is not strongly supported, so the honest output is 'insufficient' rather than overclaiming a win. Tests the system's willingness to NOT fight a weak case.
